name: Jenny Allsop
career_history: Senior Sales Director at Equinix, 3/2023 to present; Sales Director - UK Enterprise at Cloudera, 2/2021 to 3/2023; Regional Sales Director at Dell, 2/2018 to 2/2021; Account Director at Dell, 1/2004 to 2/2021; External Account Manager at Fujitsu, 2000 to 2002; Account Manager at SCC, 1996 to 2000
education: BSc Environmental Science, University of Bradford, 1992 to 1996
biography: I am an optimistic, driven sales leader. I have a broad experience across Global Customers in variety of vertical segments, most recently, telco, retail, finance & media. Taking the time to understand my customers, I recognise the importance of understanding the business challenge and defining and implementing solutions that exactly meets their needs, delivering demonstrable value. I pride myself in my leadership of an inclusive team creating an authentic environment where individuals are supported and empowered to be successful, thrive and develop.
